notes.title: Cannon Update (Large)
notes.content:
- [b]Cannon System[/b] Added
- New [b]High Score system[/b] for leaderboard 
- More Bugs than there ever should've been, I apologize 
- [b]Saving[/b] should be solved, thank you for your patience 
- The [b]pacing[/b] of the game is now completely different, my goal is to never leave the player with nothing to do, if you have any ideas please let me know, thank you!

notes.title: Small
notes.content: - Added safety reset, if all else fails with the old save system hold both "Q" and "P" together for 15 seconds to reset save.
